CustomField.description: Rich text rendered inside the section header (below title/subtitle) when Show Header is checked, passed as rich-text to the form/header component. Styled by Header Text Variant as a default block or an info/warning/error/success message card.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Additional rich text shown within the section header. Combine it with Header Text Variant to present it as a colored info, warning, error, or success card; requires Show Header.
CustomField.label: Header Text
